name: Nature Explorer Camp with KELT & Brightfield
description_short: Nature day camp run by the Kennebec Estuary Land Trust with Brightfield School educators, based at Brightfield School in Bath. Campers ages 6 to 10 ride the school van to hike, paddleboard, dig clams, explore marshes and make nature art, ending the week with a beach day at Fort Popham.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 event page: two weeks, 9 am to 3 pm, ages 6 to 10, $325 a week, up to 12 campers, $100 scholarships. Drop off and pick up at Brightfield School in Bath; registration on Brightfield School's site. ZIP is from KELT's Bath mailing address (PO Box 1128, Bath 04530).
